# Inventory report

Status: accepted

Show stock totals and export item names and quantities as CSV. Inputs have validated
nonnegative integer quantities; zero remains a valid stored quantity. Totals sum quantities,
not the number of item kinds. CSV retains input order, name,quantity headings, standard quoting
and LF endings. Empty export writes only the heading. Existing items remain unchanged.

files..work/inventory-report/map.md:
# Inventory report

## Destination

Show stock quantities and export the report as CSV.

## Decisions so far

- [Report requirements](spec.md): quantity totals and CSV behavior accepted.
- [CSV investigation](research.md): use standard CSV quoting.
- [Layout](prototype.md): accepted summary alongside item rows.

## Not yet specified

None.

## Out of scope

Remote storage and file-writing commands.
files..work/inventory-report/research.md:
# CSV quoting

Standard quoting preserves commas, quotes and embedded newlines in item names. The local
round-trip experiment checked all three and recovered the original values. Use LF line endings.
The accepted column names are name and quantity. [Specification](spec.md).
files..work/inventory-report/prototype.md:
# Report layout

Status: accepted

Keep the total quantity visible beside the item rows. The example shows three item kinds and
five total objects. The sample names and colors are flexible. [Runnable source](prototype.html)
can be opened directly in a browser. Production still needs stored-data integration and tests.
